column15: {=ARM_KR_098_1_U}A cart rolls up to the gates of Winterfell with a pale young man in it, wrapped in furs, his legs useless beneath the blankets. The guards need a long moment to know him. Bran Stark, the boy the whole North believed dead, has come home.
column16: {=ARM_KR_098_1_L}He does not weep and he does not smile. He speaks of things he cannot know, of the past and of places far away, in a calm and distant voice. Those who loved the boy he was find that he has become someone else.

column15: {=ARM_KR_098_2_U}A slight rider in a plain cloak gives a name at the gate that nobody has spoken there in years. Arya Stark is back in Winterfell, with the Twins behind her and the House of Black and White behind that. She walks the yard as if she had never left it, and goes down to the crypts first.
column16: {=ARM_KR_098_2_L}In the training yard she asks for a sword and a partner. The men-at-arms laugh until she has put three of them in the dirt without losing her breath. Whatever she learned across the narrow sea, it was not needlework.

column15: {=ARM_KR_098_2a_U}A slight rider in a plain cloak gives a name at the gate that nobody has spoken there in years: Arya Stark is home. In the yard she asks the tall knight of Tarth for a bout. Brienne holds nothing back and neither does Arya, and they fight to a standstill while the whole yard watches in silence.
column16: {=ARM_KR_098_2a_L}Later, in the godswood, Bran puts a dagger of Valyrian steel into her hand, the same blade that was once sent to open his throat. Lord Baelish brought it north as a gift, Bran says, and says nothing more about it.

column15: {=ARM_KR_099_1_U}The old masters, driven out of Astapor and Yunkai, join the slavers of Volantis and send a fleet against Meereen. Their ships fill the bay, their catapults throw fire over the walls, and their envoys climb the great pyramid to dictate the terms of the queen's surrender.
column16: {=ARM_KR_099_1_L}Daenerys answers from the sky. Her dragons fall on the fleet and turn ship after ship into burning wrecks, and the Unsullied cut down two of the masters where they stand. The third is sent home to tell the Free Cities what he saw.

column15: {=ARM_KR_099_2_U}When the smoke over the bay clears, the queen calls the small Lannister before her throne. Tyrion Lannister came to her with the Second Sons, a kinslayer with a price on his head, and his counsel has been sharp and useful since the first day.
column16: {=ARM_KR_099_2_L}She pins the badge of the Hand on his doublet. Trusted captains will hold Meereen in her name, for her eyes are fixed on Westeros now. The fleet is ready, the dragons are restless, and the wind blows west.

column15: {=ARM_KR_099_2a_U}When the smoke over the bay clears, the queen calls the small Lannister before her throne and pins the badge of the Hand on his doublet. Tyrion Lannister came to her with the Second Sons, a kinslayer with a price on his head, and she has found no sharper counsel.
column16: {=ARM_KR_099_2a_L}Yara Greyjoy kneels in the same hall and offers her longships for the crossing, if the queen will help her take the Iron Islands back from her uncle. Daenerys accepts. The fleet is ready, and the wind blows west.

column16: {=ARM_KR_100_1_L}Yara Greyjoy is taken in chains, and only a handful of her crew are pulled from the water alive. Euron sails on to King's Landing with his prize, a gift for the queen whose hand he wants.
